description:
Specifies a string pattern used when creating a users ODFC container. Use this setting to define how FSLogix will attempt to create a users ODFC container (VHD(x) file). FSLogix will use the VHDLocations or CCDLocations as the location where to search and this setting defines what to create.

NOTE: When using this configuration setting, be sure the VHDNameMatch value matches this setting.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\VHDNamePattern
Type: REG_SZ
